title: Nvidia Partners with Wall Street Giants for $500B AI Funding
description: Nvidia is partnering with major financial firms to raise significant capital for artificial intelligence infrastructure, according to recent reports.

sources.title: Nvidia and Wall Street partner on $500B AI financing
Nvidia partners with Wall Street giants to raise $500 billion for AI buildout
NVIDIA Partners With Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to Establish AI Compute Infrastructure Financing Platforms to Mobilize Over $500 Billion of Third-Party Capital

sections.heading: Major Partnership Announced
paragraphs: According to Axios, Nvidia and Wall Street are partnering on $500 billion in AI financing.
NBC News reports that Nvidia is partnering with Wall Street giants to raise $500 billion for an AI buildout.

sections.heading: Financial Partners Identified
paragraphs: The NVIDIA Newsroom states that NVIDIA is partnering with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR.

sections.heading: Infrastructure Financing Platforms
paragraphs: According to the NVIDIA Newsroom, the partnership aims to establish AI compute infrastructure financing platforms.
The goal is to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital.

faq.q: How much funding is being raised?
faq.a: According to Axios and NBC News, the partnership involves $500 billion in financing.

faq.q: Who are Nvidia's partners in this initiative?
faq.a: The NVIDIA Newsroom lists Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR as partners.
